Definition: as if from G1538 and G5119; at every time:--always.
BiblicalUsage: Hekastote means at every time, always, and Peter uses it once, for the memory he wants to leave behind. In 2 Peter 1:15 he says he will endeavour that after his decease the church may be able to have these things always in remembrance.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Peter knew he was writing his last letter, and his one wish was that the truth would outlive him.
